items.title: A bottom-up social cost of carbon for Latin America: municipality-level heat-mortality damage functions from 30 million daily death records
items.title_en: A bottom-up social cost of carbon for Latin America: municipality-level heat-mortality damage functions from 30 million daily death records
items.title_zh: 拉丁美洲的自下而上碳社会成本：基于3000万条每日死亡记录的市镇级高温致死损害函数
items.summary_en: Temperature–mortality response functions have been quantified across many climate zones, but for most of the developing world they have not been translated into country-specific economic damages at sub-national resolution. This study estimates bottom-up mortality social costs of carbon (SCC) for five Latin American countries at municipality resolution. We assemble 30 million daily death records across 10 214 municipality-equivalent units in Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador and Peru (2000–2023) and merge them with the ARCO-ERA5 reanalysis sampled at every unit centroid. Country-specific Poisson exposure–response functions, estimated separately by country with municipality, year, month and day-of-week fixed effects, recover same-day heat-mortality semi-elasticities of 10.9% (Brazil) and 13.0% (Mexico) at a daily maximum temperature of 35 °C or above, relative to a 20 °C–25°C reference. Translating these functions along the SSP2-4.5 warming path, with the transient climate response to cumulative emissions, an income-driven attenuation of the response, a value-of-statistical-life path that rises with projected income, and population ageing, yields central mortality SCCs of about USD 0.5/tCO2 in Brazil and USD 0.3/tCO2 in Mexico at a 2% discount rate, with a small negative value for cool-climate Chile and near-zero values for Ecuador and Peru. These bottom-up, mortality-only estimates are a fraction of full-system country-level SCCs but share their cross-country ordering and signs, and the underlying damage functions imply a substantial annual heat-mortality burden that the sparse regional evidence in global assessments does not capture.
items.summary_zh: 虽然已在许多气候区对温度与死亡率的响应函数进行了量化，但对于大多数发展中国家而言，这些函数尚未转化为具有亚国家分辨率的国家特定经济损失。本研究以市镇为分辨率，估算了五个拉丁美洲国家的自下而上的碳死亡率社会成本（SCC）。 我们汇集了巴西、墨西哥、智利、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁10 214个相当于市镇的行政单位（2000–2023年）的3000万条每日死亡记录，并将这些数据与以每个单位中心点为采样点的ARCO-ERA5再分析数据进行了合并。 针对各国分别估算的泊松分布暴露-反应函数（采用市镇、年、月及星期几的固定效应），得出的当日高温致死率半弹性系数分别为10.9%（巴西）和13.0% （墨西哥），该值以每日最高气温达到35 °C或以上为条件，并以20 °C–25 °C为基准。 将这些函数沿SSP2-4.5变暖路径进行转换——考虑了累积排放量引发的瞬态气候响应、由收入驱动的响应减弱效应，以及随预期收入增长而上升的“统计生命价值”路径， 以及人口老龄化等因素，在2%的贴现率下，巴西的中心死亡率SCC约为0.5美元/吨二氧化碳，墨西哥约为0.3美元/吨二氧化碳；而气候凉爽的智利呈现微小的负值，厄瓜多尔和秘鲁则接近零。 这些自下而上、仅考虑死亡因素的估算值虽仅占国家层面全系统社会成本（SCC）的一小部分，但其跨国排序和正负号与全系统估算一致；且其基础损害函数表明，每年因高温导致的死亡负担相当沉重，而全球评估中稀少的区域证据并未捕捉到这一点。

items.summary_en: Deep beneath the Pacific Ocean, scientists have discovered tiny hidden ecosystems inside metal-rich rocks that take millions of years to form. Researchers examined 244 nodules and found more than 4,100 animals living in their cracks and cavities, including unique communities unlike those in the surrounding seafloor mud. These remarkable miniature habitats could now be threatened by deep-sea mining for valuable metals.

items.title: Vertical characteristics of HCHO and NO2 in suburban Shanghai: understanding of ozone formation sensitivity via secondary HCHO
items.title_en: Vertical characteristics of HCHO and NO2 in suburban Shanghai: understanding of ozone formation sensitivity via secondary HCHO
items.title_zh: 上海郊区甲醛（HCHO）和二氧化氮（NO₂）的垂直特征：通过二次甲醛（HCHO）理解臭氧形成的敏感性
items.summary_en: Since ozone (O3) pollution in China is on the rise, vertical distribution of nitrogen dioxide (NO2) and formaldehyde (HCHO) and their role towards O3 formation are critical towards designing O3 control strategies. Seasonal characteristics of aerosols, HCHO and NO2 were investigated over suburban Shanghai using multi-axis differential optical absorption spectroscopy from June 2020 to May 2021. For HCHO, the highest average vertical mixing ratios (VMRs) were observed for summer (0.775 ppb), followed by autumn (0.719 ppb), spring (0.718 ppb) and winter (0.672 ppb) at ground level. Seasonal trends in NO2 VMRs were observed to be opposite to that of HCHO with peak values occurring during winter (2.212 ppb) at the ground level followed by autumn (1.881 ppb), spring (1.415 ppb) and summer (1.124 ppb). In vertical, aerosols depicted a Gaussian shape with a higher values between 0.2–0.5 km. An exponential decay in NO2 VMRs is observed from 0.0 km to 3.0 km while the integral component of HCHO was found to be concentrated up to 2.0 km particularly during summer months. The vertical distribution of NO2 in different seasons mainly appeared below 0.5 km, while that of HCHO appeared within the range of 0.2–1.0 km. Both aerosols and NO2 tend to be higher during haze days compared to non-haze days while HCHO was found to be higher during non-haze days owing to high photochemical activity on a clear day. Based on the ratio of HCHO to NO2 (RFN), this study attempted to quantify the vertical characteristics of O3 sensitivity for different seasons. The results indicated that the O3 sensitivity was VOC-limited both at lower (generally, 0.0–0.6 km) and higher heights (1.8–3.0 km) while some transition limited scenarios were found at middle height (0.7–1.7 km) particularly during daytime. The results depicted that secondary HCHO is a crucial factor controlling on O3 sensitivity over Shanghai where enhanced ratio of VOC limited regime was observed with secondary HCHO for all the seasons.
items.summary_zh: 鉴于中国臭氧（O₃）污染呈上升趋势，二氧化氮（NO₂）和甲醛（HCHO）的垂直分布及其在臭氧形成中的作用，对于制定臭氧控制策略至关重要。 2020年6月至2021年5月期间，利用多轴差分光学吸收光谱仪，对上海市郊区气溶胶、HCHO和NO₂的季节性特征进行了研究。 就甲醛而言，地面平均垂直混合比（VMR）在夏季最高（0.775 ppb），其次是秋季（0.719 ppb）、春季（0.718 ppb）和冬季（0.672 ppb）。 二氧化氮（NO₂）垂直混合比的季节变化趋势与甲醛（HCHO）相反，地面水平峰值出现在冬季（2.212 ppb），其次是秋季（1.881 ppb）、 春季（1.415 ppb）和夏季（1.124 ppb）。 在垂直方向上，气溶胶呈高斯分布，0.2–0.5 km高度区间内浓度较高。NO₂体积浓度从0.0 km到3.0 km呈现指数衰减，而甲醛的积分成分则主要集中在2.0 km以下，特别是在夏季。 不同季节中，NO₂的垂直分布主要出现在0.5公里以下，而HCHO的垂直分布则出现在0.2–1.0公里的范围内。 与无雾天相比，雾天期间气溶胶和 NO2 的浓度往往较高，而由于晴天光化学活性较高，无雾天期间 HCHO 的浓度则较高。 基于甲醛与二氧化氮的比值（RFN），本研究试图量化不同季节臭氧敏感性的垂直特征。 结果表明，无论在较低高度（通常为 0.0–0.6 公里）还是较高高度（1.8–3.0 公里），O3 敏感性均受 VOC 限制，而在中等高度（0.7–1.7 公里），特别是在白天，发现了一些过渡性限制情况。 结果表明，二次甲醛是控制上海地区O3敏感性的关键因素，在所有季节中，伴随二次甲醛出现时，VOC限制型状态的比例均有所增强。

items.title: Delayed seasonal march of East Asian summer monsoonal rain belt during Heinrich Stadials
items.title_en: Delayed seasonal march of East Asian summer monsoonal rain belt during Heinrich Stadials
items.title_zh: 海因里希冰期期间东亚夏季季风雨带季节性移动的延迟现象
items.summary_en: The timing and duration of monsoon rainfall shape regional hydroclimate, yet their response to abrupt climate change remains poorly constrained. Here, we use 25-km-resolution climate simulations to investigate the seasonal migration of the East Asian summer monsoon rain belt during Heinrich Stadials, periods associated with collapsed Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC). We find that the rain belt migrated northward 18 d later than during interstadials. This delay kept the monsoon front longer over central China, prolonging early-summer rainfall despite an overall weaker monsoon. The delayed migration was linked to later northward advances of the western North Pacific subtropical high and upper-level westerly jet. North Atlantic cooling contributed to these circulation changes through Rossby wave propagation and a weakened land–sea thermal contrast. Our results suggest that abrupt Atlantic changes can reshape both the amount and seasonal timing of East Asian summer rainfall. These findings offer a palaeoclimate perspective on potential changes in monsoon seasonality under future AMOC weakening.
items.summary_zh: 季风降水的时序和持续时间塑造了区域水文气候，但其对突发性气候变化的响应仍缺乏充分约束。本文利用25公里分辨率的气候模拟，研究了海因里希冰期（与大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）崩溃相关的时期）期间东亚夏季季风雨带的季节性迁移。 我们发现，与间冰期相比，雨带向北迁移的时间推迟了18天。这种延迟使季风锋面在中国中部滞留的时间更长，尽管整体季风强度减弱，但初夏降雨期仍得以延长。雨带迁移的延迟与西北太平洋副热带高压及高空西风急流向北推进的推迟有关。 北大西洋的冷却通过罗斯贝波的传播以及陆海热力对比的减弱，促成了这些环流变化。我们的研究结果表明，大西洋的突发性变化可以重塑东亚夏季降雨的总量和季节性时序。这些发现从古气候的角度，为未来AMOC减弱背景下季风季节性的潜在变化提供了参考。

items.title: Additionality of climate benefits from emission reduction and carbon dioxide removal
items.title_en: Additionality of climate benefits from emission reduction and carbon dioxide removal
items.title_zh: 减排与二氧化碳移除所带来气候效益的增量性
items.summary_en: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) has been identified as a necessary complement to industrial decarbonization for climate change mitigation. Marine CDR (mCDR) approaches, such as ocean alkalinity enhancement (OAE) and direct ocean capture (DOC), have received considerable attention for their potential to counteract ocean acidification while simultaneously reducing atmospheric CO2. However, most model-based assessments of mCDR efficacy either assume a fixed background atmospheric CO2 value or adopt an idealized future CO2 trajectory, thereby excluding impacts of important carbon cycle feedbacks that repartition carbon between the ocean, atmosphere, and biosphere. Here, we use an Earth system model to address three core questions: whether the net CO2 effect of CDR depends on background emissions; whether CDR technologies deployed simultaneously yield additive CO2 reductions; and whether there is synergy between the radiative forcing (climate) benefits of CDR and emission reductions. We evaluate permutations of direct air capture, OAE, and DOC, quantifying their individual and combined CO2 effects under various emissions scenarios. We find that the radiative forcing effects of emissions reductions and CDR are largely additive through time, regardless of background emission scenario or CDR type or scale. Furthermore, any given quantity and type of short-term CDR deployment produces a predictable, proportional and durable reduction in atmospheric CO2 through time (ΔlnCO2), facilitating comparison between CDR strategies. Finally, we show that CDR efficacy is marginally greater at low background CO2, supporting the complementary value of decarbonization and CDR in carbon management portfolios. These findings provide a robust physical basis for the design of integrated carbon management strategies and support pursuit of deep emissions cuts and CDR as synergistic climate levers.
items.summary_zh: 二氧化碳捕集与封存（CDR）已被认定为工业脱碳在减缓气候变化方面不可或缺的补充措施。 海洋二氧化碳移除（mCDR）方法，例如海洋碱度增强（OAE）和直接海洋捕获（DOC），因其既能抵消海洋酸化，又能同时减少大气中二氧化碳的潜力而备受关注。 然而，大多数基于模型的 mCDR 效用评估要么假设大气 CO₂ 背景值固定，要么采用理想化的未来 CO₂ 轨迹，从而排除了重要碳循环反馈的影响——这些反馈会在海洋、大气和生物圈之间重新分配碳。 在此，我们利用地球系统模型探讨三个核心问题：碳捕获与封存（CDR）的净二氧化碳效应是否取决于背景排放水平；同时部署的CDR技术能否产生累加的二氧化碳减排效果；以及CDR的辐射强迫（气候）效益与减排之间是否存在协同作用。 我们评估了直接空气捕获、海洋吸收增强（OAE）和直接碳捕获（DOC）的各种组合方案，量化了它们在不同排放情景下的单独及综合二氧化碳减排效果。研究发现，无论背景排放情景、CDR类型或规模如何，减排与CDR的辐射强迫效应在时间上基本呈累加关系。 此外，任何特定数量和类型的短期碳捕获与封存部署，都会随时间推移带来可预测、成比例且持久的二氧化碳浓度降低（ΔlnCO₂），从而便于对不同碳捕获与封存策略进行比较。 最后，我们表明，在低背景二氧化碳浓度下，碳捕获与封存（CDR）的效能略有提高，这印证了脱碳与CDR在碳管理组合中的互补价值。这些发现为设计综合碳管理策略提供了坚实的物理依据，并支持将深度减排与CDR作为协同的气候调控手段加以推进。

items.title: Who collects, who purchases? Land ownership and biomass acquisition in LMICs
items.title_en: Who collects, who purchases? Land ownership and biomass acquisition in LMICs
items.title_zh: 谁负责收集，谁负责采购？低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的土地所有权与生物质采购
items.summary_en: This study examines the relationship between agricultural land ownership and household fuel use behavior in low- and middle-income countries. Using harmonized household survey data from 11 countries and pooled regressions with country fixed effects, the analysis compares land-owning and landless households across three dimensions of fuel behavior: firewood collection, firewood purchase, and firewood use as the main cooking fuel. The results show that land-owning households are more likely to collect firewood, less likely to purchase it, and more likely to rely on firewood as their primary cooking fuel. These findings persist after controlling for wealth, urban residence, electricity access, and household composition. Interaction models indicate that the land–collection relationship is stable across varying contexts, while the land–purchase relationship is weaker among urban and wealthier households, suggesting that land ownership may shift households from self-collection to purchase rather than out of biomass use altogether. Time-use regressions further show that land-owning households spend more time gathering and preparing fuel, indicating that access to biomass through land lowers cash expenditures but not labor costs. Overall, the findings suggest that land ownership is an important structural determinant of household fuel use behavior and that cooking transitions may depend not only on income and infrastructure, but also on access to biomass resources through land. The analysis demonstrates that the land–energy nexus deserves greater attention in future household energy research and in policies aimed at accelerating equitable and sustained cooking transitions.
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在中低收入国家中，农业土地所有权与家庭燃料使用行为之间的关系。 本研究利用来自11个国家的标准化家庭调查数据，并采用包含国家固定效应的汇总回归分析，从三个燃料行为维度——采集薪柴、购买薪柴以及将薪柴作为主要烹饪燃料——对拥有土地的家庭与无地家庭进行了比较。 结果表明，拥有土地的家庭更倾向于采集柴火，较少购买柴火，并且更倾向于将柴火作为主要烹饪燃料。在控制了财富、城市居住状况、用电情况和家庭构成等因素后，这些发现仍然成立。 交互作用模型表明，土地与采集之间的关系在不同情境下均保持稳定，而土地与购买之间的关系在城市家庭和较富裕家庭中则较弱，这表明土地所有权可能会促使家庭从自采转向购买，而非完全放弃生物质能的使用。 时间利用回归分析进一步表明，拥有土地的家庭在采集和准备燃料上花费的时间更多，这表明通过土地获取生物质燃料虽然降低了现金支出，但并未减少劳动力成本。 总体而言，研究结果表明，土地所有权是家庭燃料使用行为的一个重要结构性决定因素，烹饪方式的转型不仅取决于收入和基础设施，还取决于通过土地获取生物质资源的途径。该分析表明，在未来的家庭能源研究以及旨在加速公平和可持续烹饪方式转型的政策中，土地与能源的关联性值得给予更多关注。
